description: This Java source file defines the ImplicitThingCreationMessageMapper class, which maps external messages to internal CreateThing signals and vice versa, used specifically for creating things with optional placeholders and headers in the Eclipse Ditto platform.

classes.name: ImplicitThingCreationMessageMapper
classes.description: A mapper class that converts external messages into CreateThing signals with support for placeholders and header substitutions, used for implicit creation of things within the Eclipse Ditto platform.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper using provided configuration properties, including the thing template, command headers, and lockout policy.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts an ExternalMessage into a list of Adaptable objects, primarily mapping messages to CreateThing signals or generating ExternalMessages from Adaptables.

methods.name: getExpressionResolver
methods.description: Creates an ExpressionResolver instance for resolving placeholders within headers using message headers.

methods.name: applyPlaceholderReplacement
methods.description: Replaces placeholders within a template string using the provided expression resolver.

methods.name: getCreateThingSignal
methods.description: Constructs a CreateThing signal from a JSON template, enriching headers and handling inline policies and policy references.

methods.name: resolveCommandHeaders
methods.description: Resolves headers in the external message by applying placeholder resolution.

methods.name: createInlinePolicyJson
methods.description: Extracts inline policy JSON from a given thing JSON if present.

methods.name: getCopyPolicyFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the 'copyPolicyFrom' property from the thing JSON if available.
